item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Watch #VISPRSD
Issued at 10:00 PM 24 November 2026

Thunderstorm is MORE LIKELY to develop over #Leyte, #SouthernLeyte, #Biliran, #EasternSamar, #Samar, #Cebu, #Bohol, #NegrosOriental, #NegrosOccidental, #Siquijor, #Palawan, #Iloilo, #Guimaras, #Antique, #Capiz, #Aklan and #OccidentalMindoro within 12 hours.

All are advised to continue monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #VISPRSD
Issued at 08:06 PM 24 November 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Cebu(MandaueCity, CityOfTalisay, Minglanilla), #NegrosOccidental(SalvadorBenedicto, SanCarlosCity), #Antique(Sebaste, Culasi) and #Aklan(Ibajay) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Cebu(CebuCity, Argao, Dalaguete), #NegrosOccidental(Calatrava, Toboso, SagayCity, CadizCity), #Aklan(Madalag and Malinao) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
